crossRefs.note: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not…
Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of…
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…

translations.web: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
translations.bsb: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
translations.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
translations.asv: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.
